description: This file defines a provider API key authentication method for a plugin system, including functions to resolve options, apply configurations, and create the authentication method with runtime dependencies.

methods.name: resolveStringOption
methods.description: Resolves a string option from the provided options object, normalizing secret input.

methods.name: resolveProfileId
methods.description: Resolves a profile ID, defaulting to providerId:default if not specified.

methods.name: resolveProfileIds
methods.description: Resolves a list of profile IDs, deduplicating and defaulting if necessary.

methods.name: applyApiKeyConfig
methods.description: Applies API key configuration to the context, updating profiles and models.

methods.name: createProviderApiKeyAuthMethod
methods.description: Creates a provider API key authentication method with runtime dependencies and execution logic.
